subject: Civil Engineering
title: Punch Lists and Project Closeout
description: A short lesson to help you apply Punch Lists and Project Closeout.

hook.text: The building looks done — but 500 items need fixing. That list is the punch list.

buildup.text: The owner and architect walk every space — noting scratches, misaligned doors, and incomplete work.

discovery.text: Each punch item must be corrected before final payment — the contractor's incentive to finish right.

twist.text: Retainage — 5-10% of the contract held back — is released only after punch list completion.

climax.text: Closeout includes as-built drawings, warranties, and O&M manuals — the building's permanent record.

punchline.text: A project isn't done when it looks done. It's done when the last punch item is fixed.

quiz.question: What is retainage in construction contracts?
options: Extra materials kept on site for future repairs
A percentage of payment held back until punch list items are completed
The contractor's profit margin on the total project
